about: One row per place the mod plugs into Hangtime!'s code. Each row generates one HookDef; preflight checks that target_type.target_method exists in the player's Assembly-CSharp.dll. 'native' means the game already calls our Technique (no Harmony patch).

columns.target_type: game class (or UnityEngine type for events)
columns.target_method: game method, or comma-separated fields for kind 'field'
columns.kind: native (the game calls our Technique) | prefix | postfix | event (Unity event we subscribe to) | field (game fields the mod reads/writes)
columns.patch_class: C# class holding it (src/Patches) or '-' for native
columns.changes_score: must be 'no': no hook may change points
columns.verified: how it was seen working in the running game, or 'no'
